entries.subject: DAMIT 5536: selected shape and spin
entries.finding: DAMIT model 5536, version 2019-10-23, pole (312°, 47°), period 7.4013 h, taken unchanged from the archive. Mirror solution 5537 recorded as an alternative.

entries.subject: Physical scale
entries.finding: 112.631 ± 1.223 km, effective diameter of a sphere fitted to thermal infrared measurements. JPL lists a diameter of 112.631 ± 1.223 km, from NEOWISE (Masiero et al. 2014, ApJ 791, 121; PDS bundle neowise_diameters_albedos 2.0). The thermal sphere diameter is transferred to the mesh as its volume-equivalent diameter.

entries.subject: PDS SBN catalogue values that disagree with the factsheet or are not shown
entries.finding: Shown rotation "7.4013 hours" (damit-models) differs from the LCDB V4.0 summary record 545 period 7.2 h (U 3, synodic); the shown value is kept. Shown size Display reference radius "56.32 km (size-calibrated model)" (jpl-small-body-database) differs from the Small Bodies Occultations V4.0 record 289, DAMIT model 5537 diameter 100 ± 4 km (volume-equivalent; DAMIT model 5537 fitted to 1 occultation); the shown value is kept.
entries.revisitWhen: A newer release of the named catalogue, or a review that replaces the shown value.

entries.subject: Messalina whole-disc color
entries.finding: Gaia Collaboration, Galluccio et al. (2023) published the mean of 10 Gaia epoch spectra of the unresolved disc: reflectance against the Sun in 16 bands from 374 to 1034 nm, 1 at 550 nm (0.971 at 462 nm, 1.008 at 638 nm). The shape is painted in that one color (#3a3938 in sRGB) through the shared disc-integrated-color method, scaled to the 4.1% geometric albedo JPL lists (± 0.5%), from NEOWISE (Masiero et al. 2014, ApJ 791, 121; PDS bundle neowise_diameters_albedos 2.0). It is one mean, not a map. Tinaut-Ruano et al. (2023), A&A 669, L14, found Gaia DR3 reflectances slightly too red at wavelengths shorter than 550 nm; the bands are used as published, without that paper's correction.
